title: Integrability of split tangent bundles on rationally connected manifolds
displayName: Integrability of split tangent bundles on rationally connected manifolds

statements.hypotheses: Smooth connected complex projective X, dim X≥2, two general points joined by a morphism P1→X; specified holomorphic splitting TX=E1⊕E2, both ranks positive.
statements.conclusion: Both specified subbundles E1 and E2 are integrable.
Smooth projective X1,X2 and X≅X1×X2 identifying Ei with pr_i*TXi.
statements.checking: Statement, application of Höring and projectivity of slices checked.

statements.hypotheses: Smooth projective complex X, fixed holomorphic TX=E1⊕E2, any holomorphic g:P1→X. Integrability not assumed.
statements.conclusion: Holomorphic F:P1×P1→X extending g on diagonal, factor tangent directions map into corresponding Ei.
statements.checking: Lemmas 2.2,2.3,2.5 and assembly pp.4–9 read; Appendix A read.

statements.conclusion: Theta_i:pr_i*(g*Ei)≅F*Ei holomorphic bundle isomorphisms, identity on diagonal.
statements.checking: Projected bracket partial connection, pullback at critical points, flatness on P1 fibers and holomorphic dependence read.

statements.hypotheses: Connected uniruled compact Kähler X with holomorphic TX=V1⊕V2; Z general RC quotient fiber, Wi=TZ∩Vi|Z.
statements.conclusion: Almost-holomorphic fibrations phi_i with RC general fibers Fi⊂Z and TFi=Wi|Fi⊂Vi|Fi; Wi=0 permits identity. If rkV1=2, exactly rankW1=2 (analytic fiber bundle TX/Y=V1), rankW1=1 (equidimensional map with rational-curve fibers tangent to V1), or W1=0 (TZ⊂V2|Z).
statements.checking: All conclusions and cited published Höring inputs checked.

proofPassages.read: Formal projector equation, O(m²) section estimate versus 2(m+1)², cancellation, wedge identities and contraction of exceptional curves.
Projected-bracket partial connection needs no integrability; flatness only after restriction to curve fibers; normalized transport.
Two-point evaluation, trivial complementary bundle, constant bracket section, spanning and identity principle.
Projectivity of general RC quotient fiber, tangent splitting, rank-zero case, external structure theorem.
Decreasing base-ideal colength, finite point blowups; countable families and submersive two-point evaluation.
